the retired standardised-distance detector reached ROC-AUC 0.994 and recall 1.000 at specificity 0.720. The real isolation forest reaches ROC-AUC 0.961 and recall 0.571 at specificity 1.000. The separation figure is LOWER, and this is reported rather than smoothed: the Run 14 anomaly families were constructed as departures from a centroid, which is precisely what the retired detector measures, so that fixture favours it. The forest trades recall for false alarms at a threshold chosen for few false alarms.
